title: 음절표 4: 그 기 개 게…
objective: You can combine a consonant with ㅡ, ㅣ, ㅐ, or ㅔ and read the syllable correctly.
summary: Read and say syllables with ㅡ, ㅣ, ㅐ, and ㅔ.

task.title: Read, build, and write
task.line: Use the vowel chart and words on page 1 to read, build, and finish each syllable.

words.exampleMeaning: Are you going to Busan by train?

letters.sound: [ɯ], written eu. Keep your lips flat, not round.
letters.as: Like 'oo' in 'good' said with a smile.

letters.sound: [ɛ], written ae. Open your mouth a little wider.
[e], written e. Most speakers say it the same as ㅐ.
letters.as: Like 'e' in 'bed' (for most speakers, the same sound as ㅐ).

exercises: Write each syllable in Roman letters: ① 스 ② 리 ③ 해
Put the consonant and vowel together into one syllable: ① ㅋ + ㅡ ② ㅂ + ㅣ ③ ㅈ + ㅔ
Read the word and choose its meaning: ① 버스 (a. bus / b. sea) ② 노래 (a. bird / b. song) ③ 테니스 (a. tennis / b. taxi)
Fill in the blank with ㅡ, ㅣ, ㅐ, or ㅔ (use the words on page 1): ① 버ㅅ__ (bus) ② ㄱ__차 (train) ③ 노ㄹ__ (song) ④ 가ㄱ__ (shop)
answers: ① seu ② ri ③ hae
① 크 ② 비 ③ 제
① a. bus ② b. song ③ a. tennis
① ㅡ (버스) ② ㅣ (기차) ③ ㅐ (노래) ④ ㅔ (가게)
